references.context: Commutative ring R with a multiplicative identity, the ambient base of prime ideals and its spectrum; no precise independent standalone ring-axioms meaning was identified in the current meanings registry.
Prime ideal p minimal in the partially ordered collection of prime ideals of R, not necessarily a minimal nonzero ideal.
Set of prime ideals q with p⊆q, endowed with subspace topology of the Zariski spectrum.

references.phrase: exactly the components V(p) for minimal primes
references.disposition: An algebraic characterization of maximal irreducible closed subsets; it does not claim all prime ideals give distinct components.

review_rationale: Read irreducible components of the affine spectrum as closed subsets V(p) for minimal prime ideals of the ring, preserving the ordering on primes and the Zariski topology.
